name: Pell the Underwritten
role: understudy awaiting a role, resident of the neighboring kingdom
portrait: a young understudy in a plain rehearsal tunic holding a script that is blank below the first line, standing in a pool of light with the rest of the stage unlit behind them
home: a dressing room shared with more performers than mirrors, costumes hung in ranked rows, a call sheet pinned to the wall with every part listed and none of them named, the corridor outside visible through an open door
favored_items: a script whose pages are ruled and numbered but written on only at the top
a prompt book with the margin notes of a director who stopped mid-scene
a spotlight gelled for a scene nobody has blocked yet
aspirations: to be given a part with an ending, drawn as a wide shot of an empty stage with a single lit mark centre floor and the seating in darkness
